reviewItem.question: For "If you have configured `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` or its YAML setting to a value other than `index/`, ensure that all the existing period…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

of.needed: whether the YAML shared_store_key_prefix setting is configured to a value other than index/

proposed.statement: If shared-store key-prefix was set to something other than `index/` for boltdb-shipper or tsdb, set `path_prefix` on all existing period configs using that index to the previously configured value.
